This overview originally included three alternative front-ends: Invidious (for YouTube), Bibliogram (for Instagram) and Nitter (for Twitter). Therefore it was named . As more projects have been added to the repository, the listed projects partially left the scope of alternative front-ends.
For example, is not a front-end, but can be generally described as an open source project that interacts with the internet platform Youtube.
Therefore the name does not capture the full scope of the listed projects anymore. Maybe this repository will be renamed in the future to better reflect the larger scope. A possible name might be or something similar.
